short_description: Fire that burns and shatters armor.
lore: He hammered the first blade from a fallen star and taught mortals that every weapon carries a spark of his forge.
passive_description: Every 3rd hit sets the target on Fire.

short_description: Thorns that wound attackers and entangle crowds.
lore: Wherever she walks, briars follow. She guards the wild places and punishes those who take more than they need.
passive_description: While above 50% health you have Thorns (reflect 20% of melee damage taken).

short_description: Blood: grow stronger with every kill.
lore: Born on the first battlefield, he grows stronger with every war and whispers to generals in their sleep.
passive_description: Each kill grants +5% attack speed for 5 s, stacking to +25%.

lore: A plague-priest who drank every poison in the world and lived. His bell tolls before every epidemic.
passive_description: When a Poisoned enemy dies, Poison spreads to enemies within 3 m.

lore: The Keeper of the Dead does not kill; she only collects. Her whip pulls souls loose from bodies that have lingered too long.
passive_description: Enemies below 15% health die when you hit them (bosses: 5%).

short_description: Unpredictable power that turns enemies into allies.
lore: The Lord of Chaos flipped a coin to decide whether the world should exist. He is still waiting to see how it lands.
passive_description: Every 10 s your next hit gets +30% damage of a random element.

lore: Buried under the dunes, the Dune Keeper dreams of the empire he once ruled; sandstorms are his restless breathing.
passive_description: After dodging, you leave a decoy that enemies attack for 2 s.

short_description: Light that brands foes and cleanses corruption.
lore: The Lady of the Dawn drives the sun across the sky with her spear. Her light reveals every lie and every hidden blade.
passive_description: Enemies marked by Light take +20% damage from all sources.

lore: The moon goddess hunts by night. Her arrows are shards of moonlight that pull the world toward darkness.
passive_description: Hits on an enemy that isn't targeting you deal +30% damage.

lore: The Warden of Winter sleeps beneath the glaciers. When he wakes, rivers stop and armies freeze where they stand.
passive_description: Frozen enemies take +40% damage from your next hit.

short_description: Drains life from everything you hit.
lore: The Mother of the Harvest blesses every harvest and takes her tithe in return: a little life from everything that grows.
passive_description: Killing a Drained enemy heals you for 3% of your max health.

short_description: Crashing waves that knock enemies back.
lore: The Lord of the Tides rules every drop of water from the swamp to the sea. Those who cross him are dragged under.
passive_description: Soaked enemies move 20% slower and take +15% Lightning damage.

lore: The Birdman Magic's guandao splits the clouds. Every thunderclap is him testing the edge of his blade.
passive_description: Every 4th hit chains lightning to 2 nearby enemies.

lore: The Wind Walker never stays in one place. She carries seeds, storms and messages to every corner of the valley.
passive_description: +15% move speed; dodging leaves a gust that knocks back enemies.

short_description: Stone that knocks foes down and slows them.
lore: The Lord of Beasts is every beast at once. His howl calls the pack, and his touch wakes the animal in all things.
passive_description: Each enemy within 5 m gives you +3% damage (max +30%).
